_comment: Manual disambiguation pins for name -> MBID. When MusicBrainz search returns multiple candidates for a band or person name, add an entry here to force the correct one. The ingestion pipeline reads this before running search, so any name in this file skips the search step entirely. Format: key = exact name as it appears in the seed CSV, value = { mbid, source: 'manual', note: 'why this pin exists' }.

Pearl Jam.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — the Seattle grunge band. MB search returns 39 hits for the name.

Nirvana.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — the Aberdeen/Seattle grunge trio. Not the 1960s UK psychedelic band of the same name.

Dave Grohl.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — the Foo Fighters/Nirvana drummer, born 1969-01-14. Has 23 member-of-band relations. Common name; verify MBID with `curl mb/artist/<id>` before adding new pins.

Oasis.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Noel & Liam Gallagher's Manchester band, begin=1991.

Blur.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — London alt-rock band, begin=1990. Not the Christian band or the 2023 project.

Motörhead.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Lemmy's London metal band, begin=1975-06. Multiple tribute-band namesakes exist.

Iron Maiden.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — the English heavy metal band, formed 1975-12-25 in Leyton, London.

Heart.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Ann & Nancy Wilson's Seattle rock band, begin=1967. Top-connected band in the graph with 42 members.

Yes.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — the British prog-rock band (Anderson/Squire), begin=1968. 'Yes' is a common English word so pin is critical.

Scream.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — DC hardcore band (Franz Stahl / Pete Stahl / Dave Grohl), NOT Primal Scream which scores higher in fuzzy search. Critical override.

Steven Wilson.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — the Porcupine Tree/Blackfield/No-Man/Storm Corrosion multi-instrumentalist, born 1967-11-03 in Kingston upon Thames. NOT the Dead Kennedys drummer (who is 'Steve Wilson' in our graph via PR 3). Critical override to prevent name collision.

Iggy Pop.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Iggy Pop / Jim Osterberg, Stooges founder. Distinct pin recommended given multiple tribute-band namesakes.

David Bowie.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — David Bowie / David Robert Jones, 1947–2016. Iconic pin.

Jimi Hendrix.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Johnny Allen Hendrix / James Marshall Hendrix, 1942–1970, Seattle-born.

Neil Young.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — the Canadian singer-songwriter (Buffalo Springfield, CSNY, Crazy Horse). MB has 3 different Neil Young entries so this pin is critical.

David Byrne.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Talking Heads frontman, Scottish-American. Distinct from the American poet of the same name.

Jack White.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — The White Stripes / Third Man / Raconteurs multi-instrumentalist. NOT the German producer Horst Nußbaum or the electronic musician.

New Order.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — UK synth pop / post-punk (Joy Division continuation), Manchester, formed 1980. MB has a distinct cover band listed with score 84.

The Fall.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Mark E. Smith's English post-punk group, Manchester, 1976–2018. Multiple namesakes including a Polish metal musician.

Gang of Four.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — English post-punk band from Leeds, formed 1976 (King/Gill/Allen/Burnham).

Public Enemy.note: Verified 2026-07-14 — US rap group (Chuck D / Flavor Flav / Terminator X). MB has 3 identical-name entries: this one, a British fascist Oi! band, and a pro-wrestling tag team. Critical override.

Run-D.M.C..note: Verified 2026-07-14 — Queens hip-hop pioneers (Rev Run / DMC / Jam Master Jay), formed 1981. Canonical MB name uses U+2010 hyphens.
